_meta.labeler: hand-labeled from source_sentence (no PDF needed for these fields)
_meta.purpose: Baseline extraction-quality measuring stick. Establishes THE NUMBER (previously none) so the Docling table-parse swap can be measured against it.
_meta.how_labeled: For each sampled extracted claim we read its source_sentence and record the CORRECT label. Where the source sentence is page furniture / a table-header fragment / a form question / bare numbers with a fabricated value, is_esg_claim=false (the extractor should not have emitted it). Multi-value table rows where a single intended value can't be pinned are value_ambiguous=true and excluded from strict value accuracy.

fields.is_esg_claim: true if this is a legitimate ESG performance/target/narrative claim; false for page furniture, form questions, or hallucinated-value fragments
fields.aspect: correct normalized aspect node (e.g. emissions.scope1); 'uncategorized' when no ontology node fits; null when not a claim
fields.value_ambiguous: true when the source is a multi-value table row and no single value is pinnable
fields.note: what the extractor got wrong (human audit trail)
